import json,subprocess
cases=[]
for i,(prim,mode) in enumerate([('allreduce',2),('reduce',3),('broadcast',2),('barrier',3),('allgather',2),('reducescatter',3),('allreduce',3),('reduce',2)]):
    K=1 if prim=='barrier' else 4
    D=0 if prim=='barrier' else 2
    evs=[{'op':'data','rank':r,'p':p,'values':[r+p,1]} for p in range(K) for r in range(4) if not(prim=='broadcast' and r!=1)]
    cases.append({'primitive':prim,'mode':mode,'root':1 if prim in ('reduce','broadcast') else 0,
                  'segments':K,'words':D,'capacity':8,'start':0,'events':evs,'trace':2})
req=json.dumps({'cases':cases})
p=subprocess.run(['python3','-I','-B','project/solver.py'],input=req.encode(),capture_output=True)
print('rc',p.returncode, p.stderr.decode()[:200])
out=json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
for c,o in zip(cases,out['cases']):
    st=o['state']
    print('%-14s mode%d b=%d occ=%d S=%s A=%s U=%s pkts=%d'%(c['primitive'],c['mode'],st[0],st[1],st[6:10],st[10:14],st[14:18],o['packets']))
    assert len(o['trace'])<=2
# check independence: run each case alone and compare the state
for c,o in zip(cases,out['cases']):
    p2=subprocess.run(['python3','-I','-B','project/solver.py'],input=json.dumps({'cases':[c]}).encode(),capture_output=True)
    o2=json.loads(p2.stdout.decode())['cases'][0]
    assert o2['state']==o['state'], (c['primitive'],o['state'],o2['state'])
    assert o2['wire_sha256']==o['wire_sha256']
print('cases are independent: OK')
EOF
